children: entered a multi-year global licensing partnership with BBC Studios that will bring Bluey to five of Mattel's franchises. The toy giant said fans around the world will be able to experience the beloved series through products from Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, Polly Pocket, and UNO beginning this fall.
Bluey first premiered in Australia in 2018 and later became available through the BBC in the UK. BBC Studios holds the global distribution and rights covering merchandise and licensing.

The collaboration was highlighted as combining the characters and stories of the hit BBC series with the unique play experiences that fans have loved for generations. The collection will feature characters from Bluey across Little People figures and playsets, Barbie dolls and accessories, Polly Pocket compact playsets, Hot Wheels vehicles, and UNO card games.

Little People's character lineup will include Bluey, Bingo, Bandit, Chilli, and more, giving young fans new ways to recreate their favorite adventures through imaginative play. Barbie will feature Bluey and Bingo across the Barbie Cutie Reveal line, with dolls dressed as Bluey and Bingo characters, delivering excitement, surprise, and fun with every unboxing. Polly Pocket, Hot Wheels, and UNO will each offer their own unique take on the series.

title: Mattel inks licensing deal with BBC Studios covering the Bluey kids series
